source_title: MS Dhoni's WhatsApp message: How Smriti shared his wishes with World Cup team - India Today
source_excerpt:
MS Dhoni messaged Smriti Mandhana, asking her to convey his congratulations to India's 2025 World Cup-winning team. He said the triumph could reshape women's cricket and inspire girls to pursue the sport professionally.
MS Dhoni is not exactly known for being glued to his phone. But after India's historic Women's World Cup triumph last year, the former India captain made an exception, sending Smriti Mandhana a WhatsApp message with a request: pass on his wishes to the entire team.
Mandhana revealed the heartwarming exchange at a promotional event featuring Dhoni, where she admitted that she was delighted to hear from someone who, by her own account, does not use his phone much.
"He actually did send me a message after the World Cup win. I know he doesn't use his phone a lot. I was very happy that he used WhatsApp to congratulate all of us," Mandhana said.
The revelation prompted a playful question from presenter Harsha Bhogle: "You saved the number?"
"I did have his number," Mandhana replied.
Dhoni then offered the explanation behind the message, revealing that Mandhana was the only player in the Indian women's team whose number he had.
"I didn't know anyone else's (number) from the team. I wanted the message to go through. We had just shot (a commercial) before that. I thought, 'Let me send a message to Smriti', and I mentioned, 'Please wish everyone who is part of the team'," Dhoni said.
